bullets.text: Fuel Crisis Threatens Telecoms - **Bangladesh** telcos warn of imminent shutdowns due to severe fuel shortages.
Satellite Deployment Setback - **AST SpaceMobile**'s BlueBird 7 satellite placed in the wrong orbit, hindering D2D services.
Potential Merger on Horizon - **Deutsche Telekom** considers merging with **T-Mobile**, creating a $267 billion entity.
Infrastructure Upgrades Underway - **Arelion** enhances Nørre Nebel site to support more subsea cable landings.
